# Jackett Mini third-party notices

Jackett Mini is a downstream GPL-2.0-only program based on Jackett v0.24.2360. The exact Jackett license is in `LICENSE`. The runtime also carries the .NET license and third-party notices copied verbatim from the pinned SDK image.

The following NuGet packages are fixed by the checked-in lock files. `nugetContentHash` values are preserved in `packaging/nuget-licenses.json`.
